findings.text: follow-on: _queued_requests_overlap compares paths each normalised against its own pointer's repo but never compares the two pointers' repos, so two queued requests in different repositories declaring the same repository-relative path are treated as overlapping and the later is held, even though the dispatch scope check it mirrors is per-repository (reckon/crew/dispatch_claims.py:1050) and would never refuse it; the delay is bounded by STARVATION_AGE_SECONDS so it is not a deadlock.

follow-on: the reviewed manifest carries neither baseline_suite nor after_suite, the two fields the review's added-failure derivation reads, so the record's added_failure_count rests on the head arms' empty failing set rather than on a base/after delta.
